info.title: Digital-E Shop API
info.description: REST API reference for the Digital-E e-commerce backend. Covers catalog browsing, Firebase authentication, guest checkout, PayOS and COD payments in VND, support tickets, payment reconciliation, webhooks, and admin operations.
